entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: ¶I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: Me hath he led, and brought into darkness, and not into light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Surely against me hath he turned again and again his hand all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: My flesh and my skin hath he wasted away, he hath broken my bones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He hath built against me, and encompassed [me] with gall and toil.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He hath made me to dwell in dark places as those that have been long dead.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He hath hedged me about that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Even when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He is unto me [as] a bear lying in wait, a lion in secret places.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I am become a derision to all my people; their song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He hath sated me with bitterness, he hath made me drunk with wormwood.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I have forgotten prosperity.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, My strength is perished, and my hope in Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Remember thou mine affliction and my wandering, the wormwood and the gall.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul hath [them] constantly in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: ¶--This I recall to heart, therefore have I hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: It is of Jehovah's loving-kindness we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: they are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul [that] seeketh him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: It is good that one should both wait, and that in silence, for the salvation of Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth:

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: He sitteth solitary and keepeth silence, because he hath laid it upon him;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: he putteth his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: he giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him; he is filled full with reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord will not cast off for ever;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: but if he have caused grief, he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses:

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: for he doth not willingly afflict or grieve the children of men.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: to turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: to wrong a man in his cause, --will not the Lord see it?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: ¶Who is he that saith, and there cometh to pass, what the Lord hath not commanded?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: Out of the mouth of the Most High doth not there proceed evil and good?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Let us lift up our heart with [our] hands unto *God in the heavens.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: ¶We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: Thou hast covered thyself with anger, and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not spared.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that prayer should not pass through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: Thou hast made us the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: All our enemies have opened their mouth against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and ruin.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water for the ruin of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: till Jehovah look down and behold from the heavens.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: They that are mine enemies without cause have chased me sore like a bird.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They have cut off my life in a pit, and cast a stone upon me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: Waters streamed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: ¶I called upon thy name, Jehovah, out of the lowest pit.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my sighing, at my cry.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: Lord, thou hast pleaded the cause of my soul, thou hast redeemed my life.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: Thou hast seen all their vengeance, all their imaginations against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, all their imaginations against me;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: the lips of those that rise up against me and their meditation against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Behold thou their sitting down and their rising up: I am their song.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: Render unto them a recompence, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: give them obduracy of heart, thy curse unto them;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
